title: Founding of Rome
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 753 B.C. (AP-11). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was provisional (Generations) 753 BC.
